_comment: Android Enterprise policy for the Asktrix agent fleet.
IMPORTANT: this is an Android Management API policy document, applied by whichever EMM the
company subscribes to (see docs/adr/0004-device-management.md). The Asktrix app is NOT the
Device Policy Controller — Google restricts AMAPI to commercial EMM vendors, and Play Protect
has blocked non-approved custom DPCs at provisioning since 2026.
Every field below is a documented AMAPI policy key. Fields the requirements ask for that have
no supported key are listed in the 'notEnforceable' block at the end rather than being faked.
name: enterprises/ENTERPRISE_ID/policies/asktrix-agent-fleet

_comment_permissions: GRANT auto-grants runtime permissions the app declares — including location and camera —
so a field agent never has to reason about a permission dialog.
NOTE: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION is NOT silently grantable by a device owner on modern
Android; the app still runs its own two-step request flow, which is why LocationSampler
_comment_userControl: Blocks force-stop and clear-data for this package (§14-§20), and as a documented side
effect exempts it from App Standby buckets — which is the closest thing AMAPI offers to

_comment_restrictions: §14-§21 and §25-§27, each mapped to a documented AMAPI policy key.
_comment_shareLocation: MUST stay false. Setting it true disables location sharing entirely and would break §10 and
§11. This is the one restriction that must NOT be maximised.
_comment_networkEscapeHatch: Lets an agent join a Wi-Fi network if mobile data fails, so a device cannot become unusable in
the field. Worth the small extra surface.
_comment_camera: Kept enabled for the optional §11 attendance photo.
_comment_playStore: Only apps listed in 'applications' are installable or visible. This is how §14-§20's 'restrict
Play Store' and 'restrict browsers' are actually enforced: the browser is simply not on the
list, so it cannot be installed. Pre-installed system browsers are handled by kioskCustomization
_comment_inputMethods: Empty array means system input methods only — a third-party keyboard could exfiltrate typed
_comment_keyguard: Notification content is hidden on the lock screen (§4).
_comment_statusReporting: §25-§27 admin visibility. powerManagementEvents is the useful one: it surfaces the OEM
battery-manager kills that silently break background location in the field.
_comment_notEnforceable: Requirements with NO supported policy key. Documented rather than faked:
1. 'Disable Nearby Share / Quick Share' — there is no dedicated AMAPI key. The nearest
enforceable controls are bluetoothSharingDisabled, outgoingBeamDisabled, and
playStoreMode=WHITELIST preventing sharing apps. Verify residual Quick Share behaviour
2. 'Disable copy/paste out of the app' — DISALLOW_CROSS_PROFILE_COPY_PASTE applies to work
profiles, not fully managed devices. On a fully managed device this must be enforced in the
app: the Asktrix contact fields have no copy affordance and no text selection.
3. 'Block all browsers' — enforced by omission from the whitelist rather than by a key.
4. 'Disable Settings entirely' — no single key. kioskCustomization.systemNavigation plus
lock-task mode is the mechanism if full kiosk is wanted; the individual *Disabled keys
above cover the settings that actually matter without the kiosk UX cost.
